dialogues.speaker: Hashimoto
dialogues.text: Did you see that? Sir Kujou Kamaji just came past here with a huge group of people.

dialogues.speaker: Nagase
dialogues.text: Could it be related to the wedding announcement?

dialogues.speaker: Hashimoto
dialogues.text: Maybe... but from the look on his face, it seems like something much more serious.

dialogues.speaker: Hashimoto
dialogues.text: He and his men seem pretty intense at the moment. Isn't it all a bit excessive for a wedding?
